questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: The angle between the tangents drawn from the point $(1,4)$ to the parabola $y^2=4 x$ is
questions.solution:
Given, $y^2=4 x$
[\therefore a=1]

General equation of parabola $=y=m x+\frac{a}{m}$
[where, $m$ is the slope]
at $(1,4) ; 4=m+\frac{a}{m}$
\Rightarrow 4=m+\frac{1}{m} \Rightarrow m^2-4 m+1=0

Let $m_1$ and $m_2$ are the roots.

\therefore \quad m_1+m_2=4 \text { and } m_1 m_2=1

Now, $\tan \theta=\frac{\left|m_1-m_2\right|}{\left|1+m_1 m_2\right|}=\frac{\sqrt{\left(m_1+m_2\right)^2-4 m_1 m_2}}{1+m_1 m_2}$
=\frac{\sqrt{(4)^2-4(1)}}{1+1}=\frac{\sqrt{16-4}}{2}=\frac{\sqrt{12}}{2}=\frac{2 \sqrt{3}}{2}

\Rightarrow \tan \theta=\sqrt{3} \Rightarrow \tan \theta=\tan \frac{\pi}{3} \Rightarrow \theta=\frac{\pi}{3}
